changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Make ActivitiesByKeyword inherit the main activity grouping from ActivitiesByMainTypes and allow the keyword to match that inherited group value.

update.column: SELECT categorized.id, categorized.grp FROM ( [[~{/GPS_TRACK/ActivitiesByMainTypes}]] ) categorized JOIN gps_track gt ON gt.id = categorized.id WHERE ( NULLIF(BTRIM(:SEARCH_WORD), '') IS NULL OR gt.meta_name ILIKE '%' || BTRIM(:SEARCH_WORD) || '%' OR gt.meta_description ILIKE '%' || BTRIM(:SEARCH_WORD) || '%' OR gt.track_name ILIKE '%' || BTRIM(:SEARCH_WORD) || '%' OR gt.track_description ILIKE '%' || BTRIM(:SEARCH_WORD) || '%' OR categorized.grp ILIKE '%' || BTRIM(:SEARCH_WORD) || '%' OR REPLACE(categorized.grp, '_', ' ') ILIKE '%' || BTRIM(:SEARCH_WORD) || '%' ) ORDER BY gt.start_date
